findings.concern: Producer invocation digests vary because the indexer hashes its database path.
findings.resolution: Comparison uses producer name/version/soundness identity; full digest remains recorded in the copied report as provenance.

findings.concern: Stage7 report JSON has no corpus fingerprint, so absence could otherwise be a reduced corpus.
findings.resolution: A mandatory version-1 scope manifest is stored and canonically hashed; any baseline mismatch refuses comparison.

findings.concern: A line move could be represented as delete-plus-add.
findings.resolution: Only the published api_surface file:function identity participates in the diff; locations are retained in report evidence, not identity.
